Jaisey Jaisey Raat Nadeem Sarwar Lyrics

1
Aik Alam Ke Saye Mein Khaimay Mehway Dua Khaimon Mein Pyasay.
Pyason Ki Aawaz Fiza Mein Shukar-e-Khuda Dohra Rahi Hai.
Door Watan Se Kuch Pardesi Seh Ke Aziyat Tashna Labi Ki.
Dekh Rahe Hain Janib-e-Darya Mauj Qayamat Dha Rahi Hai.
Aamne Samne Do Lashkar Hain Sabar Idhar Oss Ja Khanjar Hain.
Foaj Idhar Masroof-e-Ibadat Ik Taigein Chamka Rahi Hai.

2
Aik Behan Ko Fikar Yehi Hai Raat Yeh Kyun Dhalti Jati Hai.
Iss Ki Sahar Ke Pichey Pichey Subh-e-Shahadat Aa Rahi Hai.
Kehti Hain Bachoon Se Maein Aao Tumhein Hum Aaj Sajaein.
Waqt Yehi Qurbani Ka Hai Dein Pe Musibat Aa Rahi Hai.
Woh Jo Shabeeh-e-Peygamber Hai Zad Pe Sina Ki Oss Ka Jigar Hai.
Maut Ossi Ki Khatir Naiza Maqtal Mein Lehra Rahi Hai.

3
Jhola Jholne Wala Bacha Lori Sun Kar Bhi Na Soya.
Bachay Ko Aadab-e-Shahadat Lori Khud Samjha Rahi Hai.
Sath Issay Iss Ban Mein Ik Maa Baal Khulay Ba Haal-e-Pareshaan.
Jharti Hai Maqtal Ki Zameen Ko Roti Hai Thara Rahi Hai.
Rakh Do Qalam:REHAN-o-SARWAR: Dard Bhara Hai Subha Ka Manzar.
Lehja-e-Akbar Se Jo Ubhari Soot-e-Azaan Woh Aa Rahi Hai.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 18 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have three stanzas of six verses each. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Alam” as عَلَم (banner) and “Maein” as مائیں (mothers).
